business_summary: Meiho Holdings,Inc. engages in the construction and construction-related services, human resources related services, and nursing care businesses in Japan. It provides construction consulting services for public works, such as roads, rivers, and bridges, primarily to subway operators, national and local governments; and construction contract services related to roads and bridge facilities, road maintenance, repair works and railway-related construction. The company also provides human resources services related to construction engineers and manufacturing staff, the overseas outsourcing business, and security business to general contractors, manufacturers, facilities, and construction companies; the human resources services business involves dispatching administrative staff, construction engineers, and manufacturing personnel; and outsourcing services, such as creating maps and drawings, data entry, and calculations, etc. for operations of domestic real estate and manufacturing companies. Its nursing care business includes rehabilitation, hobbies and recreational activities, dementia care, flexible hours of use, and reasonably priced lunch services. Meiho Holdings,Inc. was founded in 1981 and is headquartered in Gifu, Japan.
